project.name: Castle Donington Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 14 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 57 of 57 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Castle Donington qualifies as a local detour through Castle Donington Museum and Enclosure castle at Castle Donington. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Castle Donington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Castle Donington offers Castle Donington Museum, Enclosure castle at Castle Donington, CHURCH OF ST EDWARD KING AND MARTYR within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Castle Donington Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Castle Donington Museum and Enclosure castle at Castle Donington, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
